note: One-on-one duels (src/battle/duel.ts). moves are weights; feint is the chance he shows one stance and comes another; words are said in the pauses (attr against the foe's vs).

lockside-rider.name: The rider at the gate
intro: The grey loftbuck stamps across the gate. The rider's spear comes down level. He hasn't said a word.
Watch how he sits. High, he means the spear at your head. Low, the grey's forefeet. Leaning in, a straight thrust.

hit: The spear-butt cracks across your shoulder.
The grey's hooves come down where you were nearly standing.
hurt: The grey shies; he hauls it round.
lines.yield: The spear-point drops, and stays down.
lines.down: Your blow takes him across the helm. He sways, and the grey feels it.

words.label: Sing the foal song to the grey
words.line: You sing, low, the song Larkfold sang to its foals.
words.land: The grey's ears come round. It stops dead, and won't go forward again. He has to fight you on foot now.
words.miss: The grey tosses its head and won't hear it.

words.label: "They're children. Let them through."
words.line: "They're children. Ninety of them. Let them through."
words.land: The spear-point dips. Just for a breath, it dips.

ring-tam.name: Slag Tam
intro: The Foundry ring is a square of slag-sand under the furnace hatch. Slag Tam rolls his shoulders. Half the night shift is watching.
Tam is strong and he isn't subtle. Watch his shoulders.

hit: Tam's fist lands like a dropped ingot.
He catches you on the ribs.
lines.yield: Tam spits sand, laughs, and holds up a hand. "Enough. Somebody give her my purse."
lines.down: Tam sits down hard in the slag-sand and stays there.

words.label: "Is that what they pay you for?"
words.line: "Is that what they pay you for, Tam?"
words.land: The crowd laughs. Tam goes red and wild.
words.miss: Tam grins. "They pay me to hit people like you."

ring-hesketh.name: Hesketh
intro: Hesketh was a puddler until the heat took one eye. Now he fights in the ring for coin, and he's quick, and he lies with his whole body.
He feints. If his weight looks wrong, it is.

hit: Hesketh's bar raps your knuckles.
He's past you and back before you see him go.
lines.yield: Hesketh lowers the bar. "You read me. Nobody reads me." He sounds pleased.
lines.down: Hesketh goes down on one knee and stays there, laughing at himself.

words.label: "You favour the blind side."
words.line: "You favour your blind side. You're afraid of it."
words.land: That lands. He hesitates every time now.
words.miss: "Everybody says that," he says, and comes at you from it.

ring-moll.name: Iron Moll
intro: Iron Moll has held the Foundry ring for six winters. She was a hammer-woman at the Warden forge, and she's built like the hammer.
She doesn't feint. She doesn't need to. Don't trade blows with her.

hit: Moll hits you and the world goes white.
Her forearm takes you across the chest.
hurt: For the first time, Moll steps back.
lines.yield: Moll looks at you for a long time. Then she steps out of the ring. "Yours. Look after it."
lines.down: Moll goes down. The whole Foundry Ward goes silent, then roars.

words.label: "You made Warden steel once."
words.line: "You made their steel once. Now you make them money in a ring."
words.land: Something goes out of her shoulders.
words.miss: "And now I make my own," she says.

kane-tent.name: Kane
intro: Kane, in his own tent, with his sword out. He has drilled half the Commons Army himself. He fights the way he plans: patiently.

hit: His point opens your sleeve.
The flat of his blade cracks across your wrist.
hurt: He breathes out hard through his nose.
lines.yield: He lowers the point, and looks at it as if it belongs to someone else.
lines.down: Your blow drives him back into the map table.

words.label: "You did the sum. Do it again."
words.line: "You did the sum. Four hundred against the rest. Do it again, with my brother in it."
words.land: His guard falters. He's doing it.
words.miss: "I have," he says. "It comes out the same."

words.label: "You kept me in the war. Here I am."
words.line: "You kept me in the war, Kane. Here I am. This is what you kept."
words.land: He hears it. The point wavers.
words.miss: He doesn't hear it. He doesn't let himself.

halloran.name: Halloran
intro: Halloran, in his shirt sleeves, by the fire in the inner yard. Thirty years a Warden. He doesn't waste a step.

hit: His blade comes round faster than it should.
He steps inside your guard and hits you with the hilt.
hurt: Blood on his sleeve. He looks at it, interested.
lines.yield: He sets his sword down on the stones, and sits beside it.
lines.down: Your blow takes him across the ribs.

words.label: "You drew a question mark."
words.line: "You drew a question mark where Larkfold was, and you let a man burn his home to answer it."
words.land: Something closes in his face. His next step is short.
words.miss: "That's war, Caddow. Everyone draws question marks."

words.label: "Four hundred children."
words.line: "There are four hundred children in those halls. Yours. You put them there."
words.land: He glances at the halls. Just once.
words.miss: He doesn't look. He's made a point of never looking.

halloran-two.name: Halloran
intro: Halloran, by the fire in the inner yard. Corran is beside you. Every time Halloran turns to one, the other is there.

hit: His blade comes round faster than it should.
He gets past you, and Corran is there, and only just.
hurt: He has to turn to watch Corran, and you're there.
lines.yield: He sets his sword down on the stones, and sits beside it.
lines.down: Your blow and Corran's land together.

words.label: "Look at him, Halloran."
words.line: "Look at him. Look at what you made of him, with one story."
words.land: He looks at Corran. It's a mistake, and he knows it as he makes it.
words.miss: "I made a Warden of him once. He unmade himself."

words.label: "You drew a question mark."
words.line: "You drew a question mark where Larkfold was. We found the map."
words.land: That reaches him. He didn't know it had been found.
words.miss: He shrugs. "Then you know what I am. Good."

corran-gate.name: Corran
intro: Corran, in the inner gate with the fire behind him and a fresh lull on his neck. He can't feel the heat. He can't feel anything.

hit: He hits you, and doesn't seem to notice he's done it.
He shoves you back from the gate.
hurt: Your blow lands. He doesn't flinch. He doesn't feel it.
lines.yield: He sits down in the gate, very suddenly, and looks at his hands.
lines.down: He goes down on the stones.

words.label: Sing the third line
words.line: You sing the third line of the foal song, the one he always got wrong.
words.land: He stops. Under the lull, something in him stops.
words.miss: He doesn't hear it. The lull hears everything for him.

words.label: "Finch is in there."
words.line: "Finch is in there, Corran. Get out of my way."
words.land: His face changes. The lull can't quite hold it.
words.miss: "I know," he says, calmly. "That's why it has to be me."

hallet-gate.name: Hallet
intro: Hallet, in the inner gate, in a Commons coat, with the fire behind him.

hit: He's strong. Your arm goes numb to the shoulder.
He drives you back a step toward the yard.
hurt: He grunts, and gives no ground.
He wipes his eyes. The smoke's in them.
lines.yield: He throws his sword down. "Go on, then. Go and burn with them."

words.label: "You're wearing a Commons coat."
words.line: "You're wearing a Commons coat, Hallet. There are children behind you."
words.land: He looks down at the coat. His sword drops an inch.
words.miss: "So are you. Look where it's got us."

words.label: Listen
words.line: You stop, in the smoke, and make him listen to what's coming out of the halls.
words.miss: He won't listen. He's made himself deaf to it on purpose.

road-kit.name: Kit
intro: The target range at Hollin's fair, roped off, with half the fair leaning on the rope. Kit, with a bandolier of knives and a grin. Blunted blades, first to yield.

hit: A blunted knife takes you on the shoulder. The crowd cheers.
She's behind you before you've turned.
lines.yield: Kit tosses her last knife into the straw, point first, and bows to you.
lines.down: You catch her wrist and she sits down in the grass.

words.label: "They're watching you lose."
words.line: "Listen to them. They came to watch you win."
words.land: Her grin slips. Just for a throw.
words.miss: "They came to watch me. Win or lose. That's the trick."

words.label: Watch her feet
words.line: You stop watching the knives and watch her feet.
words.land: Her next throw comes exactly where her feet said it would.
words.miss: She has no tell. Or she has a dozen.

road-gerd.name: Gerd
intro: The ring at Kestrel Fort, trampled snow inside a fence of lances, with the whole clan on the other side of it. Gerd, with a cracked rib and a war axe, and a bandage bleeding through.

hit: The axe haft takes you across the ribs. The clan roars.
He's slow. He's still faster than you'd like.
hurt: He grunts and holds his side.
lines.yield: Gerd lowers his axe and goes down on one knee.
lines.down: Gerd falls in the snow and doesn't get up.

words.label: Work his left side
words.line: You stop going for his head and go for the side he's guarding.
words.land: He bends round the rib, and his guard drops.
words.miss: He knows his own weakness better than you do.

words.label: "You don't have to do this for him."
words.line: "You don't have to bleed for him. Not like this."
words.land: For a breath his axe hangs. He looks at the stable door.
words.miss: "I'm his father. That's what fathers do."
